p-1.processFunction: Cut high-strength steel sheet (SPFC 590) to blank shape and punch locating pilot holes
p-1.failureEffect: Poor seating in subsequent forming die; potential crack at bend radius
p-1.failureCause: Punch/die clearance worn or incorrect punch sharpness
p-1.preventionControl: Tooling preventive maintenance every 25,000 strokes; carbide punch inserts
p-1.detectionControl: Optical profile projector inspection 5 pcs per 2 hours
p-1.recommendedAction: Install automated acoustic die wear acoustic sensor monitor

p-1.processFunction: Draw and form 90-degree bracket flange ribs to required CAD geometry
p-1.failureMode: Flange spring-back angle out of tolerance (89.0° vs 90.0° ± 0.5°)
p-1.failureEffect: Assembly interference during chassis bracket robot bolting at OEM line
p-1.failureCause: Yield strength variation in raw coil lot; cushion nitrogen pressure decay
p-1.preventionControl: Coil tensile cert verification per batch; nitrogen pressure transducer interlock
p-1.detectionControl: Dedicated check fixture with dial indicator 100% go/no-go pin
p-1.recommendedAction: Implement automated servo cushion closed-loop pressure feedback

p-1.processStep: OP 30: Robotic MIG Welding of Nut Plate
p-1.processFunction: Join M10 weld nuts to reinforcement bracket with structural weld penetration
p-1.failureMode: Incomplete weld penetration or spatter inside thread
p-1.failureEffect: Weld nut detachment under 45 kN crash load test or thread jamming
p-1.failureCause: Welding wire tip positioning error; shielding gas flow rate drop below 15 L/min
p-1.preventionControl: Automated wire nozzle cleaner after every 15 cycles; gas flow digital interlock
p-1.detectionControl: Push-out torque proof test (60 Nm) 3 pcs/shift + destructive cut macro once/day
p-1.recommendedAction: Add digital camera vision inspection for thread spatter detection

p-1.processFunction: Apply anti-corrosion black coating (film thickness 15 - 25 μm)
p-1.failureMode: Film thickness below 15 μm or orange peel pinholes
p-1.failureEffect: Premature rust failure before 720h salt spray requirement (TSH6528G)
p-1.failureCause: Paint bath conductivity out of range; ultrafiltration rinse flow low
p-1.preventionControl: Automated bath titration replenishment & pH dosing system
p-1.detectionControl: Electromagnetic coating thickness gage 5 pcs per rack; daily salt spray coupon
p-1.recommendedAction: Maintain daily bath log and calibrate probe weekly

p-1.description: Receive SPFC 590 high-strength steel coil, check Mill Test Certificate (MTC), verify thickness & hardness.
Blank outer contour and pierce 4 datum locating holes.
p-1.keyParameters: Stroke speed 35 SPM, Die shut height 450 mm

p-1.description: Draw 3D stiffener bead and form 90-degree mounting flanges.
p-1.keyParameters: Forming tonnage 320T, Nitrogen cushion pressure 140 bar

p-1.description: Verify 6 critical hole-to-hole center distances and flange angle.
Arc weld 2x M10 high-strength weld nuts on rear face.
Degrease, zinc phosphate pretreat, electrocoat black epoxy, oven cure 180°C 20 min.
100% check fixture verification, thread go/no-go gage, label barcode scanning into returnable steel pallet.

p-1.reactionPlan: Reject coil lot, notify purchasing and steel mill immediately

p-1.controlMethod: X-bar & R Control Chart at Press
p-1.reactionPlan: Stop press, adjust die clearance or replace punch pins
Contain last 2 hours production, 100% sort, readjust die shim

p-1.productCharacteristic: Weld Nut Push-off Strength & Thread Quality
p-1.processCharacteristic: Shielding gas flow rate & Arc current
p-1.specificationTolerance: Min 60 Nm torque, Thread M10x1.25-6H Go gage
p-1.measurementTechnique: Torque Wrench Proof Tester + Thread Plug Gage
p-1.frequency: Start of shift and after electrode service
p-1.controlMethod: Daily destructive weld section + Torque log
p-1.reactionPlan: Stop welding cell, 100% quarantine lot, repair weld parameters

p-1.productCharacteristic: Paint Film Thickness & Salt Spray Resistance
p-1.reactionPlan: Adjust voltage/conveyor speed, strip and recoat affected lot

p-1.drawingRequirement: Hole Pitch Distance (Datum C to Hole #2)
